economic_rules.common_event_calendar: Both controls require the same two consecutive observed 8h UTC funding slots, preserving raw millisecond settlement timestamps.
economic_rules.entry: floor_hour(max(available_at_k, available_at_previous)) + 1h, strictly later even if availability falls exactly on the hour.
economic_rules.native_signal: One pulse at entry_at-1h; only native next-bar shift, no extra shift and no price/volume selection.
economic_rules.overlap: Any position open at the start of the entry hour permanently skips that event, including one due to close during that hour. Never revive by same-bar reversal or later fill.
economic_rules.tail: Last executable native bar is end_exclusive-1h; skip events if entry_at+8h is later. No force_exit treated as an 8h observation.

verdict.support: Complete native audit; change gross>0, net>0 and net increment versus level>0. Positive remains LIMITED_DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORT.

unique_next_if_supported: Review only price-effect, exposure and cost attribution of this exposed-development mechanism; keep carry_nonpaying and its fixed confirmation, no second confirmation.
unique_next_if_stopped: Stop the settled-funding level/change directional branch. Reuse today discovery; the next bounded source review may select only a distinct, data-supported hypothesis. Keep the exploration slot empty without one. Continue fixed carry_nonpaying confirmation.
